product_overview: Backend service for PRD-first platform — data, business logic, integrations

general_info.name: Product Creation & Discovery
general_info.overview: Create products from text ideas and conduct guided discovery interview

goal_and_context.business_goal: Allow founders to describe product ideas in natural language and transform them into structured product definitions
goal_and_context.user_problem: Product ideas are usually unstructured; no system guides the founder through systematic discovery

business_rules.description: Product idea must be at least 10 characters
Discovery interview consists of 6 sequential questions
Discovery is complete when all questions are answered

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a founder, I want to create a product from a text idea so that the system starts discovery

bdd.then: System creates product draft and returns clarification questions

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a founder, I want to answer discovery questions so that the system builds a complete product brief

and_preconditions: At least one pending question exists
bdd.when: User submits answer to current question
bdd.then: System stores answer and returns next questions or marks discovery complete

non_functional_requirements.description: First response after idea submission ≤ 10 seconds
Discovery inputs must be versioned and auditable
System must not lose intermediate interview context on session break

test_cases.action: Call DiscoveryService.create_product with valid idea text

input.idea_text: A Telegram bot for fitness tracking

test_cases.action: Call DiscoveryService.create_product and check questions match DISCOVERY_QUESTIONS[:3]

general_info.name: Feature Map Builder
general_info.overview: Generate and approve feature maps from discovery data

goal_and_context.business_goal: Transform discovery data into a structured feature map that users can review and approve
goal_and_context.user_problem: Features are unclear and unorganized after initial idea description

business_rules.description: Feature map must be generated from discovery data
User can add, remove, rename, and reorder features
Approved feature map is stored as versioned artifact

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a founder, I want to see a generated feature map so that I can review and approve it

bdd.then: System generates initial feature list from discovery data

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a founder, I want to approve the feature map so that PRD generation can begin

non_functional_requirements.description: Feature map changes must preserve history of previous variants
Feature map UI must be understandable without internal architecture knowledge

general_info.name: Feature PRD Generator
general_info.overview: Generate feature-level PRD drafts with user stories and business rules

goal_and_context.business_goal: Create structured, canonical PRD documents for each feature
goal_and_context.user_problem: Feature specifications are incomplete and inconsistently formatted

business_rules.description: PRD must contain feature_id, acceptance_criteria with BDD scenarios, test_cases
Each PRD version is an immutable snapshot

acceptance_criteria.user_story: As a founder, I want the system to generate a PRD draft for a feature

bdd.given: Feature exists with approved feature map
bdd.then: System creates PRD version with user stories and business rules

non_functional_requirements.description: PRD draft must be uniformly structured across all features
Each PRD version must be a separately stored snapshot artifact
